dates.notes: Projected: 2026 Paper 1 final result 20 Apr 2026; 2025 about 18-19 Apr; 2024 about 24-25 Apr.

Projected from 2026 (23 Apr-2 May 2026), 2025 (23 Apr-2 May 2025) and 2024 (27 Apr-7 May 2024). Organising IIT for 2027 not officially announced; IIT Delhi is next in the usual rotation.
Single day, both papers (Paper 1 morning, Paper 2 afternoon). Not announced. Past dates: 17 May 2026, 18 May 2025, 26 May 2024 (all Sundays). Window covers the likely Sundays 16 or 23 May 2027.

recent_changes.change: Revised (reduced) JEE Main syllabus introduced from the 2024 exam. Paper still had 10 Section B numericals per subject of which any 5 were to be attempted (90 questions shown, 75 attempted).
Optional choice in Section B removed: 5 numerical questions per subject, all compulsory (75 questions in the paper). Negative marking (-1) continues for both sections.

No change to the B.E./B.Tech pattern (20 MCQ + 5 numerical per subject, +4/-1). NTA clarified on 2 Nov 2025 that no on-screen calculator is allowed. Merit is the best NTA score across the two sessions.

main_pattern.notes: 2027 Information Bulletin not released as of 2026-10-01; pattern shown is from the official 2026 bulletin (identical to 2025). Ties are broken by NTA score in Maths, then Physics, then Chemistry.

advanced_qualifying.notes: Top 2,50,000 B.E./B.Tech candidates of JEE Main (all categories), split 40.5% OPEN, 10% GEN-EWS, 27% OBC-NCL, 15% SC, 7.5% ST, with 5% PwD within each. 2026 OPEN 96,187 + OPEN-PwD 5,063; EWS 23,750+1,250; OBC-NCL 64,125+3,375; SC 35,625+1,875; ST 17,812+938. pwd = UR-PwD cutoff.

board_criterion.alternative: Be within the category-wise top 20 percentile of successful candidates of own Class XII board (same academic year). Five subjects minimum with Physics, Chemistry, Maths compulsory. 65% also applies to PwD.
board_criterion.notes: Same rule for IITs (JEE Advanced brochure) and NIT+ system (JEE Main 2026 bulletin, CSAB/JoSAA).

advanced_attempts.rule: Maximum two attempts in two consecutive years. For 2027: must have appeared in Class XII for the first time in 2026 or 2027 (so a 2027 Class 12 candidate can attempt in 2027 and 2028). Must not have been admitted to an IIT earlier.
advanced_attempts.notes: Official 2026 rule carried forward; JEE Advanced 2027 brochure/JAB eligibility not yet published. JAB briefly announced 3 attempts for 2025 (Nov 2024) and then reverted to 2; a 2026 petition for a third attempt has no JAB decision.

age_limit.rule: Born on or after 1 October 2002 (SC, ST, PwD: on or after 1 October 1997). JEE Main itself has no age limit.
age_limit.notes: Projected by shifting the official 2026 rule (born on or after 1 Oct 2001; 5-year relaxation for SC/ST/PwD) by one year.

uncertainties: No JEE Main 2027 Information Bulletin as of 2026-10-01. Only Session 1 exam dates are official (NTA tentative calendar of 16 Sep 2026: 22-24, 28-30 Jan 2027, buffer 31 Jan). Session 1 registration/result and all Session 2 dates are projected from 2024-2026.

Session 2 exam projection (1-10 Apr 2027) uses 2026: 2,4,5,6,8 Apr; 2025: 2-9 Apr; 2024: 4-12 Apr. Session 2 result projection uses 20 Apr 2026, about 18-19 Apr 2025 and about 24-25 Apr 2024 (2024 and 2025 dates are from news reports and memory of NTA notices, not re-checked against the PDFs).

JEE Advanced 2027: no date, brochure or organising IIT officially announced. IIT Delhi is expected by the JAB rotation (Roorkee 2026, Delhi last in 2020). Exam projected for mid/late May 2027 (17 May 2026, 18 May 2025, 26 May 2024); registration from 23 Apr-2 May in 2025 and 2026.

JEE Advanced 2027 attempt and age rules are not yet published; values are the 2026 official rule shifted one year. Watch for a JAB decision on attempts (there was a 3-attempt announcement and reversal for 2025).

CBSE 2027 Class 12 date sheet not out when checked (expected late Sep-Nov 2026). Window projected from 2024 (15 Feb-2 Apr), 2025 (15 Feb-4 Apr) and 2026 (17 Feb-10 Apr). No Class 12 scheme change found; the two-board-exam system applies to Class 10 only.
JEE Main percentile cutoffs for 2023-2025 are taken from coaching/education sites quoting NTA press releases, not checked against the NTA PDFs. UR-PwD cutoffs for 2023 and 2024 not confirmed (null).

JEE Advanced 2026 pattern source (jeeadv.ac.in/documents/p1_english.pdf, p2_english.pdf) is the current-year link and may move to jeeadv.ac.in/past_qps/2026_1_English.pdf next cycle. Each year all three subjects shared the same section structure within a paper.

2026 change: negative marking for multiple-correct MCQs in JEE Advanced dropped from -2 (2023-2025) to -1, and Paper 1 numericals moved to 4 per subject. The 2027 pattern is not announced and changes yearly.
JEE Main 2024 syllabus-reduction note and the 2024 Section B 'attempt any 5 of 10' detail are from general knowledge of the 2024 bulletin, not re-opened here.
